answer: A broker's policy ledger lists every client, every premium, every renewal date. A policy with no ledger entry never existed. Proof of insurance broker licence via financial services regulator is a ledger like that: a licence the financial regulator has renewed every year since 2015. Writing one false policy takes a pen; writing five hundred takes five hundred clients, five hundred premiums, and the lagoon of each is the receipt the client kept — the shale is the renewal letter, posted every year, the trellis the ledger, bound in leather and kept in the office safe.
